[RDSC.8.5] **Side condition — conditional cardinality.** [RDSC.8.1] marks
`DialectInfo` and `RealtimeContract` optional. A grammar cannot say what each is
conditional *on*, because the condition depends on a value carried in another
atom. `CapabilityInfo` is not optional: every artefact carries exactly one
([RDSC.16.2.4]).

- `DialectInfo` is present when the program's dialect is known ([RDSC.15.3]).
- `RealtimeContract` is present exactly when `CapabilityInfo.enabled` holds
  `realtime`, and absent otherwise ([RTCT.6]). The runtime must reject an artefact
  carrying a `RealtimeContract` atom whose `CapabilityInfo` does not enable
  `realtime`: the contract would bind caps nothing asked for.
